LanguageData.RR_Survivor_Inspect: Lost in the Backrooms. Will leave with anyone who can get them out.
LanguageData.RR_Survivor_OfferDesc: Offer this person a way out. They have been lost down here and will accept. Until they do, they are an inhabitant and cannot cross a gate on their own - the only way out for them is to be carried. Once they join, they can walk out with your people like anyone else.
LanguageData.RR_Survivor_NobodyHere: One of your people has to be here to make the offer.
LanguageData.RR_Survivor_JoinedText: {0} has joined the branch. They can cross a gate on their own now, which they could not do a moment ago.
LanguageData.RR_Event_SurvivorJoined: {0} was found alive in a coordinate and joined the branch.
LanguageData.RR_Event_EncounterCapRaised: The branch reached depth {0}. The Backrooms will now bring as many as {1} against them at once.
